channel.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
channel.desc: James Dainard's grandparents have recently passed, and together with his mom, Claire, James must help decide the future of the family home; the house is full of memories but also outdated, with a small kitchen and a layout that doesn't showcase its views; working with his team-construction manager Ryan and designer and realtor Megan-James aims to renovate and restore the home for top dollar.
